reply:
Open [Kilnbook](./index.html) in your browser to use the offline tracker. No installation or network connection is required.

The register starts with P01, P02, and P03 holding 4, 2, and 1 credits. Tuesday Handbuilding at 18:00 and Saturday Glazing at 10:00 each have eight seats and are dated for their next local occurrence.

Choose **Open register** to reserve a seat, record attendance, or cancel. Correcting attendance restores one credit, returns the student to reserved, and adds a dated adjustment with your reason to their balance history. Select a student to see that history.

Automated logic checks passed for capacity, duplicate booking prevention, credit use, cancellation, and corrections. The browser verification timed out, so persistence after reload remains unverified. Records use local browser storage. [Usage guide](./README.md)
